promptText: Turn on notifications so you don't miss mentions while Zazzzor is in the background.
denied: The browser blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the site settings (the icon left of the address) and come back here.
notGranted: The browser hasn't allowed notifications yet.
title: Notifications
intro: About messages that mention you, your role, @everyone or @here. While you are looking at that channel, they stay quiet.
desktopHint: When the Zazzzor window is minimised or in the background. A click opens the channel.
soundHint: A short beep, even when another channel is open.
spanForever: Until I turn it back on
untilOn: until you turn it back on
